question: In which sport did the Indian men's team win a medal at the Olympics in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian men's team won a bronze medal in Hockey at the Tokyo 2021 Olympics.**
 
• This victory marked India's first Olympic medal in hockey since the 1980 Moscow Olympics, where they won gold.
 
• The Indian men's hockey team defeated Germany 5-4 in a thrilling match to secure the bronze medal.
 
• It was a historic moment as it ended India's 41-year wait for an Olympic medal in hockey.
 
• Players like Manpreet Singh, PR Sreejesh, and Harmanpreet Singh played crucial roles in this achievement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 2021 Tokyo Olympics were held from July 23 to August 8, 2021, after being postponed from 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• India sent a contingent of over 120 athletes to compete in various sports at the Tokyo Olympics.
 
• India's overall performance at the Tokyo 2021 Olympics was one of the best in its history, with a total of seven medals (1 gold, 2 silver, and 4 bronze).
 
• The Indian women's hockey team also performed admirably, finishing in fourth place after losing to Great Britain in the bronze medal match.
 
• Neeraj Chopra won India's first-ever gold medal in athletics, in the men's javelin throw event.
